locked_selection_rule.additional_OD_sort: descending original Stage3 hourly PCE; tie break origin_zone_id then destination_zone_id

locked_graph_and_time.physical_cost: original vdf_fftt minutes once per traversal
locked_graph_and_time.physical_capacity: original effective hourly PCE / 120 per timed physical arc
locked_graph_and_time.turn_cost: original 0.001 minute engineering turn cost, no separate capacity
locked_graph_and_time.sink: zero-cost accounting exit at any legal destination arrival, not physical storage
locked_graph_and_time.time_graph_pruning: exact directed reachability for selected OD union only; this may change retained support but not original road source or attributes

resource_gate_before_build.shared_lock: original mcl_batch_guard.py heavy; --wait 0; C06 and C01 priority; no timer or poll
resource_gate_before_build.memory_rule: estimate exact relevant commodity-arc count using frozen time rule and old 1121.244 bytes/variable plus 512MiB; build only if estimate <= 75 percent of contemporaneous available physical memory; otherwise record resource gate and stop heavy work
resource_gate_before_build.solve_rule: after input-only AON screening, attempt one bounded CG full-graph pricing certificate; if gate fails report actual bounds without shrinking OD

capacity_active_label_rule: only if independently verified constrained objective exceeds unconstrained shortest-path lower bound beyond 1e-6 PCE-min and affected resource/path evidence is identified
geographic_control_G: perform only if same-source, same-direction, cost/capacity-compatible existing outer ring is proven; otherwise GEOGRAPHIC_CAUSALITY_NOT_TESTED
